svg.title: In-place and synchronous updates of the same automaton, re-run with seed 1
svg.desc: Two space-time diagrams from a re-run of the notebook model with numpy seed 1, 9 rows by 17 cells each. Top: the notebook's in-place update. After step 1 the right side, cells 9 to 15, is already full, and the left side gains one cell per step through step 7. Final row: empty G A T T A A T A A T T G C A A empty. Bottom: a synchronous variant where every cell reads the previous step. The filled block grows by one cell on each side per step through step 7. Final row: empty A T T A T A T A A T G T A A G empty.
svg.text: Synchronous update, each step reads the previous one
